en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded exhibition ground with a large rectangular reflecting pool in the foreground and an elaborate mud‑brick style palace or pavilion in the background. The architecture resembles Sahelian/Sudanese style with crenellated walls and towers. Numerous visitors walk along the paths and gather near the building. Printed text at the top and bottom identifies it as a view from the 1931 International Colonial Exhibition in Paris, specifically the palace seen from the Indochina section.
